info.title: Micetro
info.description:
Micetro is a DDI (DNS-DHCP-IPAM) management platform providing unified control of DNS zones and records, DHCP scopes, reservations, and address pools, and IP address space across on-prem and cloud networks.

Authentication: HTTP Basic Auth (Micetro user's login name and password). The API also supports Bearer session tokens, NTLM, and Kerberos, but Basic Auth is used here since it requires no separate session-login call.
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 96 of 511 upstream operations covering DNS zones/records/servers/views, DHCP scopes/reservations/servers/superscopes/address pools/exclusions/groups, and IPAM organizations/ranges/address blocks/IP address records. See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.

gateway.description: The IP address of the gateway.

VLANID.description: The VLAN ID for the interface.

PropertyType.description: Defines the possible data types for a custom property.

ProviderProperties.description: Bag of properties as key-value pairs.

RangeChange.description: Contains all properties for a range change object.

ReportCategory.description: Defines the possible categories of a report.

RoleAccess.description: All access bits for a role

general.description: Read-only. True if this role is applied to all objects of this type, in general.

accessEntries.description: The access flags for the role

partition.description: application directory partition to use if type is 'partition'.

AWSLogin.description: Contains all information needed to log into an AWS account.

secretAccessKey.description: Secret access key for the AWS account to log into.

accessToken.description: Access Token for the Akamai account to log into.

AzureLogin.description: Contains all information needed to log into an Azure account.

clientID.description: Client ID for the Azure account to log into.

clientSecret.description: Client secret for the Azure account to log into.

isGovernment.description: Use Azure Government. Defaults to false.

alsoNotify.description: List of other servers to notify.

noRefresh.description: The time between the most recent refresh of a record timestamp and the moment when the timestamp may be refreshed again.

refresh.description: The time between the earliest moment when a record timestamp can be refreshed and the earliest moment when the record can be scavenged. The refresh interval must be longer than the maximum record refresh period.

VNet.description: Contains the id and link name of an Azure VNet

linkname.description: The name of the VNet link.

registrationEnabled.description: Specifies whether auto-registration of virtual machine records in the virtual network in the Private DNS zone is enabled.

name.description: The name of the logging channel.

file.description: The log file name, if type is "File".

size.description: The maximum log file size, if type is "File".

versions.description: The log file versions, if type is "File".

MSDNSServerLogLevel.description: Contains all properties for MS DNS server loglevel.

outgoing.description: Log outgoing. If not logged, incoming must be logged.

incoming.description: Log incoming. If not logged, outgoing must be logged.

tcp.description: Log TCP. If not logged, udp must be logged.

udp.description: Log UDP. If not logged, tcp must be logged.

queries.description: Log queries. If not logged, updates and/or notifications must be logged.

updates.description: Log updates. If not logged, queries and/or notifications must be logged.

notifications.description: Log notifications. If not logged, queries and/or updates must be logged.

request.description: Log request. If not logged, response must be logged.

response.description: Log response. If not logged, request must be logged.
